applies_to: Numbered reference lists whose behaviour does not depend on which journal style produced them.

cases.note: "References" is the one thing that legitimately precedes the first entry and is not itself a reference.
cases.text: References 1. Doll R. First. BMJ. 1954. 2. Wynder EL. Second. NEJM. 1961. 3. Peto R. Third. BMJ. 1994.
